message.content: LiHua mentions playing "The Witcher 3" multiple times, highlighting its rich and engaging story, side quests, and character development. She particularly appreciates the way the game incorporates multiple narrative threads and character arcs, making it a standout title for storytelling. While she hasn't mentioned playing "The Last of Us," which was recommended by Thane Chambers, "The Witcher 3" appears to be the game that LiHua finds particularly adept at using various storytelling tropes effectively.
